scenario: AITA for not helping a mother buy milk? | I know this sounds bad. And before people tear into me please hear me out. I tell her sorry but I can't, don't have cash. She asked if I'd use my card and I said no, I'm on a budget. I finally said if it's so important put back the bag of chips and soda, that I'm not paying for her shit.
